operational_resume.diagnosis: Snapshot 38200364291 shipped an internally inconsistent tree. Diffing its team namespace against the accepted base (lab/frontier/frontier-query-retrieval, byte-identical to snapshot 38196996329 for that namespace) showed 13 changed files: 2 legitimate (verify_determinism.py absolute --out fix, +34-line regression test) and 11 from a stale 'generation-A' adapter copy that overwrote ocl_adapter/__init__.py, bundle.py, cli.py, client.py and expansion.py and added ocl_adapter/{deduplication,retrieval}.py, contracts/INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md, fixtures/{generate_fixtures.py,minimal_fixture.json} and tests/test_adapter.py (files present on no other ref in the repository). The overwrite removed AdapterConfig/build_candidate_bundle/bundle_summary/build_variants/to_product_bundle/validate_against_product/validate_candidate_bundle from the public API, left pipeline and fixtures unimportable, dropped OCLClient, and replaced the CLI with one that rejects --preset fixtures. Measured effect: only 15 of 57 unit tests could be discovered (3 import errors) and the contract-import bridge was dead. It went unnoticed because every claim-bearing artifact of that run was produced BEFORE the overwrite (verification 03:38:20Z, live evidence 03:40:48Z, determinism probe 03:43:02Z) and nothing re-ran afterwards; the state record was never advanced and no report was written. The run's own determinism probe also reported deterministic=false, but that was the probe's relative --out defect (n_candidates=null, both children exit 0), which the same run correctly diagnosed and fixed.
